title: Reservations onramp activation pilot and surge strategy for new instance families
creator: Maya Chen
description: Run a controlled onramp pilot for new dedicated instance families (g7x-burstable, c8y) in three regions with a surge-credit mechanism to smooth initial capacity activation. This ticket coordinates cross-functional GTM activities: pricing and reservation SKUs, billing alignment for pro-rated surge credits, partner sales enablement, console UX copy and reservation flow changes, release notes sequencing, and runbook updates for SRE/ops. Goal: validate activation friction, measure reservation conversion rates, and ensure no billing surprises for early customers.
acceptance_criteria: Pilot launched in 3 regions (us-west-2, eu-central-1, ap-southeast-1) with SKU families g7x-burstable and c8y on the Dedicated surface
Surge-credit policy implemented in billing backend and validated with synthetic activation tests
Console reservation flow updated with contextual help and tooltip copy reviewed by UX and Legal
Release notes drafted and approved for customer-facing channels and partner enablement deck completed
Runbook for SRE/Oncall updated and smoke-tested (activation, quota exhaustion, fallback)
tasks: Finalize SKU definitions and price bands with Revenue Ops (deadline 2025-11-10)
Implement surge-credit ledger entries and pro-rate logic in billing (ENG work: create feature flag)
Console: add onboarding modal copy + reservation promo banner (DES review)
Prepare partner enablement packet: slide deck, FAQ, sample contracts
QA: runactivation smoke tests with 50 synthetic customers and 1M tokens/day load
Create customer-facing release notes and internal release timeline
Coordinate with Sales Ops to assign promo codes to pilot customers
